input.story: November was quite depressing initially. But just as Diwali started, things started getting better, my friends came over to cook food and celebrate me moving out. I also celebrated Diwali with my family at home. I found a very cute and unique lady bug at office. I feel like not all was bad this month, there were some really dark days while there were some really beautiful days. I will cherish it all
